entry_rule: Buy at the open of the first trading day after signal date T
exit_rule: Sell at the open of the 21st trading day after signal date T
signal_timing_rule: The factor is constructed only from information available at signal date T. Future price is label data only.
execution_constraint_note: Suspension, limit-up and tradability constraints will be introduced in the later strategy backtest, not in this first IC label.

coverage_metric_note.forward_return_valid_in_research_univers: Valid price labels among stocks in the signal-date research universe.
coverage_metric_note.factor_return_paired: Stocks with both a final factor value and a valid future return label.
